interests.canonicalKey: MLA|Northern Ireland|sin ad mclaughlin|visits|4 9 june 2023 i visited washington dc to attend the women peace and security wps parliamentary exchange with the united states wps caucus and the wps focal points network capital level meeting travel costs for flights approximately 550 five nights accommodation costs in hotel zena approximately 700 and an allowance for food and incidentals us 294 were met by secretary s office of global women s issues s gwi us department of state registered 6 july 2023 29 november 1 december 2022 i visited helsinki to attend the helsinki policy forum women parliamentarian network wpn travel costs for flights approximately 400 and two nights accommodation costs in the radisson blu hotel helsinki approximately 280 were met by forward thinking registered 6 july 2023 6 8 december 2023 i visited windsor to attend the helsinki policy forum women parliamentarian network wpn the cost of two nights accommodation at st george s house meals and airport transfers from heathrow airport to st george s house estimated to be approximately 700 were met by forward thinking the cost of flights were met personally registered 12 december 2023
interests.interestText: 4-9 June 2023: I visited Washington DC to attend the Women, Peace and Security (WPS) Parliamentary Exchange with the United States WPS Caucus and the WPS-Focal Points Network Capital Level Meeting. Travel costs for flights (approximately �550), five nights' accommodation costs in Hotel Zena (approximately �700) and an allowance for food and incidentals (US$294) were met by Secretary's Office of Global Women's Issues (S/GWI), US Department of State. (Registered 6 July 2023) 29 November-1 December 2022: I visited Helsinki to attend the Helsinki Policy Forum Women Parliamentarian Network (WPN). Travel costs for flights (approximately �400) and two nights' accommodation costs in the Radisson Blu Hotel Helsinki (approximately �280) were met by Forward Thinking. (Registered 6 July 2023) 6-8 December 2023: I visited Windsor to attend the Helsinki Policy Forum Women Parliamentarian Network (WPN). The cost of two nights' accommodation at St George's House, meals and airport transfers from Heathrow Airport to St George's House (estimated to be approximately �700), were met by Forward Thinking. The cost of flights were met personally. (Registered 12 December 2023)
